memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, works as postal worker, reports occasional migraine limiting activity.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: no falls in past 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 0 regular (new patient).
mood: reports occasional irritability, denies depression.
carers: spouse Priya, partner.
goal: "I want to keep working without migraines stopping me."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
propranolol 40 mg OD
sumatriptan 50 mg SOS
topiramate 25 mg HS
naproxen 500 mg SOS
salbutamol MDI SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD
montelukast 10 mg HS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (80% predicted), FVC 3.6 L (85% predicted), FEV1/FVC 78% (normal).
Asthma Control Test score: 22/25 (well controlled).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Neurological examination: normal cranial nerves, no focal deficits, normal coordination and gait.
CT head (non‑contrast): no acute hemorrhage, infarct or mass; within normal limits.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: works full‑time, migraines reduced to 2‑3 per month, reports occasional wheeze after exertion.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: no falls, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (polypharmacy) – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: stable, denies anxiety or depression.
carers: spouse Priya, partner.
goal: "I’d like fewer migraine days and to keep my breathing easy."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
propranolol 60 OD (increased for better migraine prophylaxis)
sumatriptan 50 mg SOS
topiramate 25 mg HS
naproxen 500 mg SOS
salbutamol MDI SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD
montelukast 10 mg HS

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Neurology, Dr S. Reddy, for refractory migraine despite prophylactic propranolol and topiramate. Request advice on preventive options and possible botulinum toxin.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Neurology reply: migraine frequency now 1‑2/month on current regimen. Suggest continue propranolol 60 mg OD, consider adding amitriptyline 10 mg HS if needed. No botulinum toxin indicated at present.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been having more sinus pressure and my asthma feels a bit tighter when I climb stairs to the fourth floor at work. My headaches are still rare but I worry about the sinus.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:

cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: no falls, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:

Basic metabolic panel: Na 138 mmol/L (135‑145), K 4.2 (3.5‑5.0), creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Spirometry with reversibility: FEV1 2.7 L (78% pred), FVC 3.5 L (83% pred), FEV1/FVC 77%. Post‑bronchodilator FEV1 2.9 L (84% pred) – 7% improvement, consistent with asthma.
Asthma Control Test score: 20/25 (well controlled).
